34.title: Gate 34: POWER
34.note: Detailed teaching is transcribed/paraphrased only from the verified Complete Rave I’Ching extraction; no missing interpretation has been filled from general Human Design knowledge.

channel_teachings.34-57: Power, A design of an archetype
channel_teachings.20-34: Charisma, A design where thoughts must be deeds
channel_teachings.10-34: Exploration, A design of following one's convictions

34.teaching: The source presents Gate 34 as powerful Sacral energy: available for use, capable of fuelling three different channels, and closely connected with independent action and conviction. It also stresses that this power is not aware in itself, and that awareness matters in how the power is expressed.
34.keynote: Power is only great when its display or use serves the common good.

lines.title: Triumph
lines.theme: The freedom in absolute victory to unlimited use of power.

lines.title: Momentum
lines.theme: The power that grows when victory is in sight.
